#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
Quick performance test to ensure the fix doesn't significantly impact performance
"""

import time
from django.utils.html import urlize

def performance_test():
    """Test performance of urlize with various inputs"""
    
    test_cases = [
        # Simple URL
        'Visit http://example.com for more info.',
        
        # URL with entities
        'Check out http://example.com/?q=1<test> for details.',
        
        # Multiple URLs
        'Visit http://example.com and https://google.com and www.github.com.',
        
        # Long text with entities
        'This is a long text with multiple URLs like http://example.com/?q=1<test> and https://google.com/?search="hello world" and also www.github.com/user/repo. ' * 10,
        
        # Text without URLs
        'This is just plain text without any URLs or entities.',
        
        # Text with entities but no URLs
        'This text has <entities> and "quotes" but no URLs.',
    ]
    
    print("Performance test:")
    
    for i, test_case in enumerate(test_cases, 1):
        # Warm up
        for _ in range(10):
            urlize(test_case)
        
        # Time the operation
        start_time = time.time()
        iterations = 1000
        for _ in range(iterations):
            result = urlize(test_case)
        end_time = time.time()
        
        total_time = end_time - start_time
        avg_time = total_time / iterations * 1000  # Convert to milliseconds
        
        print(f"Test {i}: {avg_time:.3f}ms per call (input length: {len(test_case)} chars)")
    
    print("\nPerformance test completed. The fix should not significantly impact performance.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    performance_test()
